name: compact-function-catalog
goal: Function cards show only a name, a description of at most 80 characters and the small open icon; contracts stay on the entity page.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Function cards show only a name, at most 80 description characters and an icon; full details stay on the entity page.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing standardized grid tests required contracts in cards. Reverse those assertions, add character-boundary checks and preserve accessible revision navigation.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Clean snapshot dfee79a6 fails the existing grid assertions at all three widths. Red record d57ca4ac preserves the unchanged test corpus.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Removed contract, consumers, badges and test controls. The shared function card caps descriptions at 80 Unicode characters and retains revision-safe navigation.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Clean snapshots dfee79a6 and fa315247 run identical frozen tests: red d57ca4ac fails, green passes all three viewport cases with contracts still reachable.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Reports formatting, types, lint, all unit tests, builds and audit pass; three viewport browser cases pass. Native checks stay paused, so the root aggregate is not claimed.
